hero.subtitle: I turn complex data into clear decisions. Specialising in Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and Python-powered analytics — delivering platforms that drive real business outcomes.

paragraphs: I'm a Data Analyst and Microsoft Fabric Engineer who turns complex data into clear business impact. I specialize in banking analytics, loan portfolio analysis, FP&A collaboration, accounts receivable, WIP, and utilization optimization.

With deep expertise in Microsoft Fabric, I design end-to-end data platforms — from ingestion pipelines and Lakehouses to semantic models and reporting layers — so teams can make faster, more confident decisions.
My delivery combines engineering precision and analytics storytelling, with strong experience in cross-functional teamwork, stakeholder alignment, and automation for repeatable data operations.
Every project is driven by one goal: make data more trustworthy, accessible, and actionable for the people who need it most.

skills.name: Microsoft Fabric
skills.desc: End-to-end data platform engineering — Lakehouses, Data Pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, Semantic Models, Warehouses, and Real-Time Analytics.

skills.name: AI & GenAI

skills.name: Power BI
skills.desc: Enterprise reporting, DAX measures, semantic model design, Row-Level Security, paginated reports, and Fabric-native Power BI integration.

projects.name: Loan Portfolio Analytics
projects.desc: Delivered advanced loan portfolio reporting and risk analytics to improve portfolio health, tracking delinquencies, exposure, and collections performance.
projects.overview: Developed a comprehensive loan portfolio analytics solution.
projects.problem: The business lacked consolidated visibility into loan portfolio health.
projects.architecture: Source systems → Alteryx → Semantic model → Power BI.
approach: Consolidated loan data into a Fabric lakehouse.
Built risk-tiered KPIs for delinquency and collections.
insights: High-risk customers concentrated in small segments.
Delinquencies increased in specific credit score ranges.
Manual reporting replaced by automated monthly review.

projects.name: Credit Card Analytics
projects.desc: Built credit card spend and risk dashboards that surfaced customer behavior, approval trends, and loss forecasts for sharper credit decisioning.
projects.overview: Created analytics to uncover credit card trends and risk signals.
projects.problem: Credit card teams lacked a unified view of spend behavior and approvals.
projects.architecture: Source → Fabric pipelines → Analytics layer → Power BI.
approach: Aggregated card transaction data into a central Fabric lakehouse.
Built KPIs for spend, churn, and approval performance.
Created Power BI dashboards with segmentation filters.
insights: Approval rates varied by segment and geography.
High-risk behavior surfaced in select product categories.
projects.tools: Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, SQL, Alteryx

projects.name: Employee Utilisation Optimization
projects.desc: Designed utilization dashboards and WIP metrics for HR and finance, helping managers balance capacity, project staffing, and productivity.
projects.overview: Delivered utilization dashboards and WIP tracking.
projects.problem: Teams had limited visibility into employee workload and utilization.
projects.architecture: Assignment + time data in Fabric → dashboards.
approach: Integrated time, project, and resource data.
insights: Some teams over-utilized while others had surplus.
WIP reporting helped prioritize high-value work.
projects.tools: Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, SQL, Alteryx

projects.name: Fabric Data Platform Delivery
projects.desc: Delivered a scalable data platform with Fabric lakehouses, data pipelines, and automated reporting to support finance, operations, and analytics teams.
projects.overview: Built a modern Fabric data platform.
projects.problem: Legacy platforms were slow and fragmented.
projects.architecture: Source ingestion → Fabric lakehouses → Semantic models → Power BI.
approach: Designed Fabric landing zone and lakehouse architecture.
Developed standard semantic models and pipelines.
projects.tools: Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Dataflows, OneLake

projects.name: Alteryx Automation Project
projects.desc: Built automated Alteryx workflows to transform finance and operations data, eliminating manual tasks and accelerating month-end reporting.
projects.overview: Automated manual finance workflows using Alteryx.
projects.problem: Manual data prep was consuming high effort.

projects.name: Fabric Automation Project
projects.desc: Automated Fabric pipeline orchestration and deployment to streamline analytics delivery and maintain consistent, governed data flows.
projects.problem: Analytics workflows were manual and prone to delays.
projects.architecture: Fabric pipelines → lakehouse → semantic models → monitoring.
